Description: Dr. Jess Wade is a physicist in the Blackett Lab in London who specializes in Raman spectroscopy. She achieved her PhD at Imperial College London in 2016 studying nanometrology in organic semiconductors. She now works as a postdoctoral research associate at Imperial, where she is a member of a solid-state physics research group. In addition to her research, she is a very public advocate for gender equality in STEM, serving on the WISE Campaign Young Women's Board and the Women's Engineering society council to work with educators across her country to increase diversity in STEM education. Additionally, she has written two children's books about materials and nanoscience to increase young interest in physics.
